test_pct_change_basic: test the pct_change method on a datetime series to compute percentage change between consecutive values
test_pct_change_with_periods: test the pct_change method with custom periods argument to compute percentage change over multiple periods
test_pct_change_with_freq: test the pct_change method with a frequency argument like 5D or 5B to compute percentage change over date offsets
test_pct_change_with_duplicate_axis: test the pct_change method on a series with duplicate indices to verify correct behavior with repeated index labels
test_pct_change_shift_over_nas: test the pct_change method on a series containing NaN values to verify correct handling of missing data
